notes.title: True Visions v0.4 Patch is coming!
notes.notes:
The reason why we made you wait so long is that we went to update the game engine. We upgraded from Unreal Engine version 4.24 to 4.27 and it took time to fix many many bugs and add updates. So we apologize to you.

[previewyoutube=-_T64PVje2s;full][/previewyoutube]

First foremost, thank you to all of you who have supported us since our early launch date. We have been taking notes on all the criticisms and feedback you have given us for the Early Access build. Therefore, the next few updates will be focused on smoothing and improving the game mechanics.

The first change will be to the movement mechanics and environment. While your character had free reign over the house itself, they were unable to go to the front or backyards. With the new update, you will have access to the yards and will be able to decorate them.

The next change will address the issue of limited movement in the Design Mode. In the current patch Design Mode allows you to get a top-down view, however your ability to zoom in and out was heavily restrained. With the new update, the limits to that will be higher.

Our third and final update for this patch will be a new feature. As it is now, you can move with the movement keys and control your camera with your mouse. With the new patch, you will be able to drag your character with just the mouse. By holding down M1 you can move your camera to a new location, or alternatively, you can simply click on an empty space to automatically go there. 
We have integrated Character and Design Modes. From now on, the Design Mode’s camera will pick up from where your Character leaves off and vice versa.

We are working hard to achieve better and more beautiful interactions with the objects. You can change the colour of different parts of many objects independently, and with this update the number of objects you have control over will increase. You will also be able to paint not only the objects but the walls as well. Future updates will focus on adding independent colour support for the floor, the ceiling and the walls. 

Lastly, we are finally able to implement the #1 request we have been getting since Early Access launch; the save system. From now on instead of losing your progress every time you close the game, you can continue from various saves.

Thank you once again for your support. You can reach us through our Discord server for more news, feedback and questions. See you in the next patch.

notes.title: New Patch News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40994352/445089f1ff09a13e6d677e8df93e5eb5ee665731.png[/img]

Hello Visionaries,
First of all, we would like to thank you all for your amazing support. Despite the game being out for only a month we have received a lot of positive and negative feedback from you beautiful people. Thank you to everyone who believed in us. Instead of Rolling out very small updates, we decided to push back our updating schedule to offer a more comprehensive update.

[b]Graphic Settings Have Been Reworked[/b]
There were several complaints about the quality of the textures. We have reworked the textures to make them better and less faulty. We have also updated a few details like environment lighting etc.

[b]Saving and Loading Game[/b]
One of the most common feedbacks was about the lack of save and load system. With this update, you will able to save and load your houses whenever you want.

[b]A New Character[/b]
In the last update, you met Liam. Now, we introduce you to Chelsea, our second character.

[b]Walls[/b]
In this update, you will be able to paint walls. You can choose whichever colour you like. In the following updates you will be able to interact with the walls, floors and ceilings more.

[b]Objects[/b]
Some objects had bugs and problems (like having empty backs) that needed to be fixed. These issues have been corrected. Some objects have been temporarily disabled to be reworked. They will be added back to the game as soon as possible.

[b]New Houses[/b]
We are trying to offer you, our players, as many new features as we can before the Campaign Mode launches. One of these features is new houses. Wİth the new update you get 2 more houses to design.


Your feedback is incredibly important to us. If you have things you wish to share, please consider joining our Discord and reaching out to us.

notes.title: 0.3.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Visionaries! We are here with the new update. Without further ado, let's see what happened.

- Roof view map has arrived.
- A map has been added for the tutorial.
- Camera rotation speed increased in Design Mode.
- Movement and rotation speed increased when you interact with objects.
- Fixed the interaction problems with the door.

The next update will be on graphics, lighting and gameplay. Your feedback is very important to us. You can let us know your ideas via Discord or e-mail. See you later!

notes.title: True Visions Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40994352/5f255aa7c4674684d099d696907918ea52fb9a63.png[/img]

Countdown has started on the game we started developing 1 year ago! We have decided upon our release date after updating and tweaking the game in regards to your feedback during the Steam Fest. True Visions will be available as Early Access on December 30th 2021. Here are some of the details:

[b]Pricing[/b]
One of the first things we had agreed on when we started the development was the pricing that would reflect the scope of the game, and this hasn’t changed. The game will be 10 US Dollars.

[b]Early Access Process[/b]
We are working as fast as we can to present you with the new features we are planning on adding. This includes many features that will enrich your game experience in our story and creative game modes.

[b]Languages[/b]
The game will be released in 4 languages currently. These are English, German, Portuguese and Turkish. We have plans to add the French, Iralian, Russian and Chinese languages in further updates.

[b]Social Media[/b]
We have a Discord server for you to reach us easily. Furthermore, we will be uploading informational videos about the game, our future plans and the development process on our Youtube channel.
